name: 깃소금 · 저승길 차림
silhouette: 머리 위의 거대한 후광과 몸 주변을 휘감는 톱니바퀴 꼬리, 거대한 렌치 실루엣
signature_motion: 주변의 톱니바퀴가 시계 방향으로 빠르게 회전함
signature_vfx: 황금빛 바람이 나선형으로 캐릭터를 감싸며 휘몰아침
visual_en: A small 3-head tall figure with deep navy scaled skin and short starlight silver hair. On top of the head, a large floating golden halo radiates intense light. Transparent crystal horns protrude from the forehead. A long dragon tail embedded with rotating golden gears sweeps behind. The character wears a deep indigo cosmic jumpsuit adorned with glowing star dust, paired with heavy metallic gold gloves and heavy mechanical boots with glowing cyan energy lines. Around the body, several golden clockwork gears float in a swirling motion, creating a divine aura of orbiting mechanical elements.
features_en: Underworld Road outfit: an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality
pose_en: Standing rigidly with a precise, clockwork-like posture.
vfx_en: A few bold golden wind streaks shooting forward and small sparkles

derive.prompt: Keep this exact same character: the same face, head, hair, body shape, size, pose and skin, and the same hands holding the same weapon in the same place. Change only the clothing and accessories to an Underworld Road outfit for the new update: white Korean mourning clothes, a black gat hat of an underworld reaper (jeoseung saja) and small ledger (myeongbu) ornaments, matched to its own weapon and personality. Keep the body colors readable on both dark stone and light grey floors (not all black, not all white). Full body, three-quarter view facing right.
